purpose: Verify the current frozen controller can stably realize the empirical 1.0 N lower guard and distinguish 0.25 N adjacent commands before any boundary-seeking object rollout.
resource_requirement: Run only after protected Mass/E3/E5 Isaac work releases capacity.
note: The 0.25 N points span the planned 1-4.25 N qualification region. This is a minimal interface calibration, not a force-outcome sweep and not a Direct training dataset.
